posts.en:
dsh-browser-control is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Playwright MCP browser control for AI agents: drive a real, visible Chrome (navigate/click/type/snapshot + ~80 browser_* tools), with a live screenshot panel embedded in the GUI that refreshes after every action.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-d2ce8425b2098d438746.html
